model: Exact existing full27B UD-Q4_K_M + matching BF16projector, digests unchanged
only_effective_policy_change: laptop RPC worker sets GGML_METAL_NO_RESIDENCY=1; mini explicitly unsets it. Same40/24 placement, mmap, fit-off, context8192, image1024 and normal-pressure gates asv2.

host_budgets.scope: Model-accounting estimate, not measured residency or available RAM. Staging and all runtime buffers need not coexist, but are retained as a conservative risk. OS/apps/driver add demand; no blind subtraction from global footprint.

memory_policy: Do not claim these estimates fit with ordinary applications. One guard-bounded load-only diagnostic, no prompt generation, no automatic retry/scaling or inference/service promotion. Stop on either pressure!=1, deadline/log errors or cleanup uncertainty.
anticipated_phase_risks: Laptop allocation vs first write vs first graph may shift pressure
resource_identity_limits: Backend recommended-free and process RSS/footprint are not total host capacity. Source-derived bytes are exact payloads, reserves are estimates. Physical result decides admission.
stop_after_repeated_failure: If this third full-model diagnostic also fails, preserve it and reassess the serving architecture rather than another blind parameter retry.
